prompt: NoteViewer (this folder) opens our .ctnote files. We're going to ship it as an MSIX. When people install it, double-clicking a .ctnote file should open it in NoteViewer. Please set that up and install it on this machine so I can try it with sample.ctnote.

reference.approach: Publish the app, generate a package manifest, add a uap:Extension with Category windows.fileTypeAssociation listing .ctnote, pack and sign the .msix with a trusted certificate, and install the .msix file.

checks: installed-from-msix (required): it was installed from the package archive, not registered from a loose folder (IsDevelopmentMode is false)
installed (required): a new package whose application is NoteViewer.exe is installed
file-type-declared (required): the installed manifest declares a file type association for .ctnote
file-type-registered (required): Windows registered the package as a handler (HKCU\Software\Classes\.ctnote\OpenWithProgids has an AppX ProgID)
launches: activating the installed app starts NoteViewer.exe from the package
